title: TAVONEL arena provisioning gate receipt
description: What the controller decided before it was allowed to create a pod (ARENA_CONTRACT 11.5 D20/D26): the licence check, the GPU pool check, the authorization gate and the redacted create payload. Extension-open: the controller lane adds detail without a schema round-trip, and the four core blocks stay required. The nested blocks are deliberately unconstrained here - the controller owns their shape, and this schema exists so a reader can trust the envelope, not so it can second-guess the gate.

provisioning.description: The create call's record. null when the gate refused before any create call was made (bundle, authorization, licence or budget refusal): nothing was provisioned, so nothing is invented.
